verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bland's customer-facing voice agents, plus an MCP server and plugin that let external AI coding agents operate a Bland account. None of that is a built-in assistant inside the product that the user can delegate tasks to. The MCP server, plugin and CLI are external-client access paths, an adjacent capability that earns no credit here. An in-app copilot is a fair axis for a SaaS platform, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
